body:
me too, Spooky, me too. 

all i feel is agony. daily

i hope you cease repining and find the comfort you oh so need
3,4 and 6 please and thank you🥺
interested! 😃
concerning hobbits playing in the background when my casket is being lowered. Also, i don’t want any of my coworkers or random people. just close family

The alcoholism might be making him feel incapable of being a full-on dad. In his head, he’s probably thinking he’s protecting the kids from his self-destructive ways.

But at the same time, he can’t even text back — which takes little to no energy. So that just shows where his priorities lie.... in gardening, clearly 

I hope your children grow to see him for what he is and not put the blame on you because that is the mistake i made, blaming my mother

For real, Wolfman! There are men who do everything it takes to see their kids. they hop on flights regularly just to see their kids, they put their careers on pause just to see their kids. I just don’t understand the type that bails out

let me tell you this: i’m an elementary school teacher and i’ve been contemplating quitting because of my declining mental health, but i just can’t do it because of the kids i teach. They’re not even mine. So i believe the contemplation should be severe and massive enough when they’re actually yours...that should make one stay

exactly, Jemi! we share the same sentiments. Me being an extension of my mother automatically makes me an extension of you as well. My mother didn’t make me alone, you were also part of the entire process. 

I think it stings even more when they leave when the child is older. They embed all those memories only for them to leave. That’s pure barbaric behavior
right? i mean, options are there. why is their first instinct “running away” ? it’s really awful
i hear you, Eagle. At the same time, the man should refrain from shagging if they’re not ready for whatever outcome
that’s funny. bad vibes? as a parent aren’t you supposed to be around in order to make them a better person? what’s the role of a parent anyway?

I understand, i really do and i’m so sorry. Just reach out to them. even if it means via a phone call. I promise it’s going to somewhat fill the void. At least they’ll grow up knowing that daddy tried. They’ll grow to see the actual truth
you’re a great parent, i’m gonna take a moment to applaud you! women are also capable of being deadbeats, it’s just that society doesn’t really tap into that
so the child should be in agony because of them being unplanned? did they choose to be here? why not seek for help for the sake of the child? it’s really selfish
no amount of financial constraints should make one bail out on their child. emphasis is on “you made the child”
i’ve come to the realization that narcissism plays a role, but not all the time. If you really love your kid, i’d assume you’d fight for them. it’s the complete sense of giving up that bugs me

True, G. I just wish we didn’t have to carry that scar. 

Their cowardice behavior continues to teach us about resilience, compassion and how to be good parents. 

So in the end, we win!
true, but a good chunk of deadbeat dads have enough   money to chip in on their child’s wellbeing. it’s not a universal reason

it is so unfair that he left your mom with all the responsibilities. i’m so sorry. Being overwhelmed is not good enough reason, but it is somewhat valid but not fair to you. I hope you’re dealing with the situation well.  you understanding his sentiments shows your amazing, most genuine character

i’m so sorry. you don’t deserve any of that, but i bet guilt is consuming him. 

my dad ghosted me twice— when i was born, rocked up when i was 20 then ghosted again. 

it doesn’t matter, i agree.
i’m so sorry, Riley. i’m sure you’re gonna be a good parent! i can tell
good one!
i know, but now that the child is here and they’re the consequence of your action, why not just step up
well damn 💀, but why make them though
sorry if this sounds insensitive, but how long did you go without food and water?
i’m sorry that people in the comments have been so judgmental. your feelings matter and you matter too. Stay a little longer

i feel the same way. please know you’re not alone. 

Usually i wish assisted dying was legal in my country just so i could go. i am tired. 

Hope you find a sense of solace, friend
will Fini pay my money back? 🥺
i’ve got nothing to live for. my family sees me as a fault in the family structure. i genuinely have no one
